title: per-prompt CI: add quality gating + eval metrics integration
author: Aisha Patel
release_notes: Adds per-prompt quality gating to the eval CI pipeline and integrates per-prompt metrics export for longitudinal monitoring. No user-facing API changes.
description:
Motivation: We've seen intermittent prompt-level regressions slip through the aggregate eval check because a small subset of prompts regress while overall metrics remain stable. This PR adds per-prompt quality gating and wires per-prompt metrics into the CI artifacts so regressions are caught earlier and are actionable.

What this does: Adds a per-prompt gating step to the eval CI workflow (ci/workflows/eval-ci.yml) that fails the run when any prompt in a configured prompt-set exceeds configured regression thresholds. Adds a metrics exporter that writes per-prompt delta metrics and example traces as CI artifacts and uploads summarized CSV to the metrics bucket for downstream dashboards. Adds tests and docs.

Implementation notes: - New gating logic implemented in ci/eval_harness/prompt_gating.py with a short, documented interface: gate_on_thresholds(results, baseline, thresholds). Gate thresholds are configurable via env and ci config (defaults conservative). - Per-prompt metrics calculation lives in eval_harness/metrics/per_prompt.py and reuses existing metric primitives. - CI workflow updated to run the gating step after eval metrics are computed and to publish artifacts. - Tests: unit tests in tests/test_prompt_gating.py cover boundary behavior and flaky-tolerant aggregation.

Checklist: - [x] Add gating implementation - [x] Wire into eval CI workflow - [x] Export per-prompt CSV artifacts - [x] Unit tests covering edge cases - [x] Add docs for configuring thresholds in docs/ci/prompt_gating.md - [x] Smoke-validated on canary branch

Commits summary: 1) add per-prompt metrics exporter and gating logic (Aisha Patel) 2) update CI workflow to run gating + publish artifacts (Aisha Patel) 3) tests + docs + small refactor to reuse metric primitives (Aisha Patel)

Files changed (high level): ci/eval_harness/prompt_gating.py -- new gating implementation; eval_harness/metrics/per_prompt.py -- per-prompt metric computation; ci/workflows/eval-ci.yml -- add gating step and artifact upload; tests/test_prompt_gating.py -- unit tests; docs/ci/prompt_gating.md -- docs; tools/ci/upload_metrics.py -- helper to push CSVs to metrics bucket; small updates to eval_harness/config/defaults.py to add gating defaults.

CI checks: Detailed runs showed transient failures on one flaky test (now stabilized). All required checks (build, unit-tests, eval-metrics, gating-smoke) passed on the final run. Artifacts uploaded to the metrics-staging bucket for downstream dashboards.

Rationale and follow-ups: Thresholds are intentionally conservative for initial rollout; follow-up work (ENG-4601) will add automatic threshold tuning and a dashboard that highlights consistently failing prompts to help triage. This PR intentionally avoids changing default thresholds globally; team leads can opt into stricter gating per-project.

Merge: squashed after approvals and minor test fix.

impact: prevents regressions at prompt-granularity from slipping through aggregate metrics; may cause CI failures for projects with unstable prompt sets until thresholds are tuned.
